The settings its catalog gives the alias (rapid-mlx info qwen3.5-4b-4bit): 512-token prefill steps, the hermes tool parser and the qwen3 reasoning parser (both detected from the folder too); its MTP is opt-in for this model (q35-4b-rapidmlx-mtp). One sequence, 32K context. No telemetry (--no-telemetry, RAPID_MLX_TELEMETRY=0, DO_NOT_TRACK=1), no version check, no downloads, no disk caches (--disable-disk-caches: no prefix-cache snapshot or KV checkpoints on disk; the in-memory prefix cache stays on), a fresh HOME per run. Without speculation it serves this vision checkpoint on its multimodal path: 80.4 tok/s at T = 0.6 in short runs, 81.8 with --no-mllm.
